title: Reconnaître les verbes du récit littéraire
summary: Recognition track: identify être, avoir, faire, voir, vivre, venir, tenir and derivatives in literary narration.
objectives: Decode all six persons of the main irregular literary-past families.
Distinguish vis as voir or vivre through person and context.
Retell a literary passage without importing its register into ordinary speech.

sections.title: Être and avoir: a -u- family
paragraphs: Recognize être's fu- and avoir's eu- literary stems. These are complete verbs in the passé simple, not shortened participles. Fut has no circumflex; fût belongs to a different, literary imperfect-subjunctive form. Eut and eût have the same distinction. This course assesses reading the past simple, not producing those literary subjunctives.
Passé-simple être can mark a bounded state or reaction: elle fut surprise. A state is not automatically imperfect; the writer's viewpoint matters.

mistakes.avoid: Il fût surpris en lisant la lettre.
mistakes.prefer: Il fut surpris en lisant la lettre.
mistakes.why: For the independent literary-past assertion intended here, fut has no circumflex.

sections.title: Three verbs, two ending families
paragraphs: Faire's literary forms are fis, fis, fit, fîmes, fîtes, firent. Voir's are vis, vis, vit, vîmes, vîtes, virent. Vivre uses the vécu- family: vécus, vécus, vécut, vécûmes, vécûtes, vécurent.

Je vis can mean I live (present vivre) or I saw (past-simple voir). Present voir is je vois, meaning I see. Je vis does not mean I lived in passé simple: that is je vécus. Decode a whole sentence rather than assigning one tense to an isolated spelling.

mistakes.avoid: Elle vit dix ans dans ce village avant de partir en 1890.
mistakes.prefer: Elle vécut dix ans dans ce village avant de partir en 1890.
mistakes.why: For the intended completed literary-past residence, vivre is vécut; vit would be present vivre or literary-past voir.

sections.title: The -in- family and its prefixes
paragraphs: Venir and tenir use the endings -ins, -ins, -int, -înmes, -întes, -inrent attached to v- and t-. Their derivatives keep the prefix. Revenir gives revins, revins, revint, revînmes, revîntes, revinrent; obtenir gives obtins, obtins, obtint, obtînmes, obtîntes, obtinrent. Devenir, intervenir, retenir and maintenir follow their respective family.
Read the surrounding complements for meaning: tenir une corde means hold a rope; tenir une promesse means keep a promise. The conjugation does not change with these related senses.

practice.prompt: Recognition only: give the infinitive of furent.
practice.explanation: Furent is third-person plural literary être.

practice.prompt: Recognition only: give the infinitive of eûtes.
practice.explanation: Eûtes is the vous literary form.

practice.prompt: Recognition only: give the infinitive of firent.
Recognition only: give the infinitive of vécurent.
Recognition only: give the infinitive of vîmes.
Recognition only: give the infinitive of obtinrent.
practice.explanation: Obtenir retains the tenir family's literary pattern.

practice.prompt: Retell Elle fut surprise in passé composé. Replace only fut.
practice.explanation: Literary être transfers to compound avoir + été.

practice.prompt: Retell Ils eurent peur in passé composé. Replace only eurent.
Retell Nous fîmes une pause in passé composé. Replace only fîmes.
Retell Vous vîtes le phare in passé composé. Replace only vîtes.
Retell Elle vécut ici deux ans in passé composé. Replace only vécut.
Retell Elles revinrent in passé composé. Supply only the verb phrase.
practice.explanation: Revenir takes être with feminine plural agreement.

practice.prompt: In the literary sentence Je vis une lumière et je courus vers elle, what does vis mean?
practice.explanation: The direct object une lumière and the event sequence identify voir.

practice.prompt: Retell Il tint sa promesse in passé composé. Replace only tint.
practice.explanation: Tenir has participle tenu and avoir.

production_task.prompt: Read this original passage and retell it in conversational passé composé: Le médecin vint au village. Il vit la source et fit analyser l'eau. Les habitants furent rassurés. Do not produce new literary conjugations.
production_task.model_answer: Le médecin est venu au village. Il a vu la source et a fait analyser l'eau. Les habitants ont été rassurés.
production_task.translation: The doctor came to the village. He saw the spring and had the water analysed. The residents were reassured.
rubric: Vint, vit, fit and furent are correctly understood.
The retelling uses natural compound past forms.
Venir uses être while voir and faire use avoir.
The causative meaning 'had analysed' is preserved.
